description: Beyond the paper. The paper's largest simulated size is m=30, where the Appendix B budget already covers only 0.2% of the space. At m=42 it covers 7e-07, so % optimal goes to zero and mean relative error becomes the metric -- the same shift the paper's own TSP m=29 row shows. Tests whether the click-density result survives when the search is a vanishing fraction of the space, or whether it was an artifact of the regime where the budget is still appreciable. Independent bernoulli clicks at 1.15x the click rate, the density that won at m=30.
